detail: The r4 N15 CHECK asked whether prefill-level pins (UserChoseRefcheckAction → empty/effective prefill) and 'fires nothing' assertions were added. Dispatch pins were; these were not: the substitute-empty test injects an already-empty fixture, never exercising view_edit_trio's fallback arm; validation tests assert only the error field, not effect.none().
recommended_fix: Add a handler test asserting UserChoseRefcheckAction(RefcheckSubstitute) opens an empty prefill trio, and assert the returned effect is none() in both validation-block tests.

title: NEW: no_forbidden_words_test scans only toast/page arms — the RC4.3 implementer-authored refcheck strings bypass the 'error'/'failed'/'retry' ban
detail: This PR extended no_em_dash_test to scan refcheck_action_strings (the strings for_each_copy cannot reach) but no_forbidden_words_test still scans only for_each_copy. No current string violates, but a future 'Retry'/'Failed' in refcheck copy ships silently — the same blind spot r1 W1 closed for em-dashes.
recommended_fix: Add the list.each(refcheck_action_strings(), ...) loop to no_forbidden_words_test, mirroring the em-dash test's extension.
